problem: Uses "dạng gốc" — a one-off outlier not used anywhere else in the corpus for this concept — instead of the canonical "dạng từ điển".
Uses "dạng nguyên thể" standalone instead of the canonical "dạng từ điển", for the same 받다/드→해요 conjugation point that other units call "dạng từ điển".
Section heading renders "Dictionary Form" as "dạng nguyên thể" instead of the canonical "dạng từ điển" — a high-visibility contradiction since it is the lesson title itself.
Uses "dạng nguyên thể" standalone instead of the canonical "dạng từ điển" immediately under the mistranslated title.

Stage-menu name uses "Liên âm", a different Vietnamese word than the "Nối âm" used in every other occurrence of this concept (titles, body text, prompts, completion message) — a learner will see the stage list name a phenomenon differently than the lesson that teaches it.

Uses "từ đếm" instead of the canonical "đơn vị đếm" for the same 명 counter explained two steps earlier.
Introduces the counter concept as "danh từ đơn vị" instead of the canonical "đơn vị đếm" used by every meaning line in the same lesson (steps 20, 21, 22).
